description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer, which enforces proper return types on Orleans grain interface methods, ensuring they are asynchronous (Task, Task<T>, ValueTask, ValueTask<T>) or void, to adhere to Orleans distributed system constraints.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the analyzer that enforces valid return types for Orleans grain interface methods.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeNoError
methods.description: Tests that valid asynchronous and void return types do not trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: IncompatibleGrainInterfaceMethodReturnType
methods.description: Tests that a synchronous return type (int) in a grain interface method triggers an error diagnostic.

methods.name: StaticInterfaceMethodsWithRegularReturnsAreAllowed
methods.description: Verifies static interface methods with any return type are allowed and do not trigger diagnostics.
